defaults.BROADCAST_KICK_TEXT: %nick% has been kicked from this server.
defaults.BROADCAST_BAN_TEXT: %nick% has been banned from this server.

configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server as shown on the public server list. [Unity Rich Text](https://docs.unity3d.com/Packages/com.unity.ugui@1.0/manual/StyledText.html) formatting is allowed. The server must be [verified](https://scpsl.notion.site/How-do-I-verify-my-server-A-step-by-step-guide-34235d219dce43c7bf47b7c158fa069d) to appear on the list

configurationFields.label: Player List Server Title
configurationFields.description: Sets the server title (name) displayed only in the player list. Specify "default" to use the Server Name

configurationFields.label: Player List Server Title Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the time interval between refreshes of the server title in the player list. Specify "default" instead of a number to use the default set by the server

configurationFields.label: Server Info Pastebin ID
configurationFields.description: Sets the pastebin ID used for the info tab on the server browser. The ID can be found in your browser's web address bar when creating a new file on pastebin. Required for the server to be included on the public server list

configurationFields.label: Contact Email
configurationFields.description: Sets the contact email address of the server owner or adminstrator, as used to verify the server. Required for the server to be included on the public server list

configurationFields.label: Hide From Public List
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will be hidden from the public server list, even if otherwise verified and accessible

configurationFields.label: Enable Online Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the server to connect to the central servers. Otherwise, UserID based bans, reserved slots, the whitelist, and remote admin authentication will also be disabled

configurationFields.label: Display Custom Whitelist Status
configurationFields.description: If set, the public server list will show the server as using a whitelist. ONLY enable this if the server is verified and uses a plugin or modification that provides a custom whitelist. See the [Verified Server Rules](https://scpslgame.com/Verified_server_rules.pdf) for details

configurationFields.label: Display Access Restriction Status
configurationFields.description: If set, the public server list will show the server as having access restrictions. ONLY enable this if the server is verified and uses a plugin or modification that restricts access other than by whitelist (such as password). See the [Verified Server Rules](https://scpslgame.com/Verified_server_rules.pdf) for details

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players that may connect to the server at one time. Cannot generally exceed 60 for a server to be included on the public server list

configurationFields.label: Enable Player Whitelist
configurationFields.description: If set, only whitelisted players will be able to join, as specified in config/UserIDWhitelist.txt

configurationFields.label: IP Banning
configurationFields.description: If set, IP banning will be enabled. Disable this if the server is behind a proxy, firewall, or anti-DDoS system that changes IP addresses from players to own

configurationFields.label: Server Tickrate
configurationFields.description: Sets the server tickrate (fps)

configurationFields.label: Lobby Waiting Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the waiting time before the game starts. Specify "default" instead of a number to use the default set by the server

configurationFields.label: Use Reserved Slots
configurationFields.description: If set, reserved slots will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Query Protocol
configurationFields.description: Enables the server's query protocol

configurationFields.label: Enable Query Protocol Over IPv6
configurationFields.description: If set, the query protocol will be enabled over IPv6

configurationFields.label: Administrator Query Password
configurationFields.description: Sets the administrator password for the query protocol

configurationFields.label: Map Seed
configurationFields.description: Forces a single map seed for all rounds. -1 = random

configurationFields.label: IPv4 Server Binding
configurationFields.description: If required, you can change the IPv4 binding of the server by changing the Application IP Binding for this instance

configurationFields.label: IPv6 Server Binding
configurationFields.description: Sets the IPv6 binding of the server. Default is :: (all IPs). Change to a specific IPv6 address on the host if really needed

configurationFields.label: Public IP Selection Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whether GSCS should automatically select the public IP advertised for the server, or whether it should use the IP set under Server Public IP

configurationFields.label: Server Public IP
configurationFields.description: Sets the public IP advertised for the server, if "Manual" is selected as the Public IP Selection Mode. Useful if the host network has multiple public IPs, or the server is behind a public proxy

configurationFields.label: Server Plugins
configurationFields.description: Server plugins using the Northwood LabAPI must be downloaded to the 'AppData/SCP Secret Laboratory/LabAPI/plugins/<GamePort>' directory in the instance datastore. Plugins using the EXILED plugin framework must be downloaded to the 'AppData/EXILED/Plugins' directory, and EXILED must be installed using the "Install EXILED" setting under the Updates menu. More [information on plugins](https://scpsl.notion.site/How-do-I-install-plugins-on-my-server-e7a64ab5b0e541a59333ffbaab2f52c5)

configurationFields.label: Enable Rate Limit Kick
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will kick a player after they exceed the command rate limits. Otherwise, command execution will just be disabled

configurationFields.label: Prevent Same Account Joining
configurationFields.description: If set, prevents players with the same account from joining the server simultaneously

configurationFields.label: Enable Anticheat Console Output
configurationFields.description: If set, anticheat-related messages will be displayed in the server console

configurationFields.label: Display Pre-authentication Logs
configurationFields.description: If enabled, logs related to pre-authentication will be displayed in the server console

configurationFields.label: Rejection Logging Suppression Threshold
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period before a new rejection is logged (when using the Query Response System)

configurationFields.label: Challenge Issuance Logging Suppression Threshold
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period before a new challenge issuance is logged

configurationFields.label: Enable UPnP
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will automatically create port mappings on UPnP enabled routers

configurationFields.label: Additional LocalAdmin Startup Parameters
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional LocalAdmin (not server binary) startup parameters that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care (don't set any path arguments)

configurationFields.label: Additional Server Startup Parameters
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional server binary (not LocalAdmin) startup parameters that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care (don't set any path arguments)

configurationFields.label: Server Forced Class
configurationFields.description: Sets the forced class on round start. -1 = random

configurationFields.label: Player Information Range
configurationFields.description: Sets the default range that the player information text appears on clients

configurationFields.label: Stamina Balance Use
configurationFields.description: Sets the percentage of stamina used per second while sprinting. Express as a decimal, eg: 0.05 = 5%, 0.33 = 33%. Stamina is currently only utilised on humans. 0 = disabled, but this will cause weirdness with status effects and other mechanics

configurationFields.label: Stamina Balance Immunity
configurationFields.description: Sets the period during which newly-spawned players can sprint without consuming stamina. Used to reduce visual artifacts. Recommended minimum = 2

configurationFields.label: Stamina Balance Regeneration Cooldown
configurationFields.description: Sets the period that must pass before stamina starts regenerating after the player stops sprinting. Lower values are more likely to be exploited by players. Higher higher can be annoying to players

configurationFields.label: Stamina Balance Regeneration Speed
configurationFields.description: Sets how fast the stamina regenerates. This is a multiplier for the default setting, which is based on a curve - not a specific value

configurationFields.label: AFK Period Before Kick
configurationFields.description: Sets how long a player can be AFK in their spawn location before being kicked by the server. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Constantly Check AFK Status
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will constantly check AFK status

configurationFields.label: AFK Kick Message
configurationFields.description: Sets the message shown to a player when kicked for AFK

configurationFields.label: Intercom Cooldown Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the intercom cooldown period after use

configurationFields.label: Intercom Maximum Speech Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum period that a player can use the intercom at one time

configurationFields.label: Auto Round Restart Delay
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period after a round has ended for the round to restart

configurationFields.label: Enable Fast Round Restart
configurationFields.description: If set, enables faster round restart after a round has ended

configurationFields.label: Fast Round Restart Delay
configurationFields.description: Sets the length of time after a round has ended for the round to restart

configurationFields.label: Enable Friendly Fire
configurationFields.description: If set, friendly fire for humans will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Friendly Fire Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the friendly fire multiplier

configurationFields.label: Warhead Detonation Countdown Timer
configurationFields.description: Sets the countdown timer until the warhead detonates

configurationFields.label: Force Gates Open During Detonation Timer
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the entrance gates will be forced open when the warhead is counting down

configurationFields.label: Lock Checkpoints During Detonation Timer
configurationFields.description: If enabled, all checkpoints will be locked when the warhead is counting down, thereby isolating zones

configurationFields.label: Force Doors/Checkpoints Open During Detonation Timer
configurationFields.description: If enabled, all normal doors and checkpoints will be foced open when the warhead is counting down

configurationFields.label: Keep Items After Escaping
configurationFields.description: If enabled, when a player escapes they will keep old items, rather than the items falling on the ground

configurationFields.label: Allow Playing As Tutorial
configurationFields.description: If set, players will be able to play as the tutorial class

configurationFields.label: Disable Decontamination
configurationFields.description: If set, disables the decontamination process in the facility

configurationFields.label: Allow SCP-096 To Destroy Locked Doors
configurationFields.description: If enabled, locked doors can be destroyed by SCP-096

configurationFields.label: Disable Holidays
configurationFields.description: If set, disables the holidays and other generation events (like Halloween)

configurationFields.label: Allow Disarmed Interaction
configurationFields.description: If set, handcuffed players will be able to interact with doors or elevators

configurationFields.label: SCP-914 Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets how SCP-914 operates on players

configurationFields.label: Sinkhole Slow Amount
configurationFields.description: Sets how much the sinkhole makes a player slower

configurationFields.label: Sinkhole Spawn Chance
configurationFields.description: Sets the chance of spawning a sinkhole. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Disconnect Drop
configurationFields.description: If enabled, disconnecting players will drop their items

configurationFields.label: End Round On One Player
configurationFields.description: If enabled, a round ends when there is only one player left

configurationFields.label: Change Teams For Handcuffed Escapees
configurationFields.description: If enabled, handcuffed escapees will change teams

configurationFields.label: Pocket Dimension Exit Count
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of exits in the pocket dimension

configurationFields.label: Broadcast Kicks
configurationFields.description: If set, enables broadcasts for player kicks

configurationFields.label: Broadcast Kick Text
configurationFields.description: Sets the text that is displayed when a player gets kicked
configurationFields.default: %nick% has been kicked from this server.

configurationFields.label: Broadcast Kick Duration
configurationFields.description: Sets the broadcast kick message duration

configurationFields.label: Broadcast Bans
configurationFields.description: If set, enables broadcasts for player bans

configurationFields.label: Broadcast Ban Text
configurationFields.description: Sets the text that is displayed when a player gets banned
configurationFields.default: %nick% has been banned from this server.

configurationFields.label: Broadcast Ban Duration
configurationFields.description: Sets the broadcast ban message duration

configurationFields.label: Enable Spawn Protection
configurationFields.description: If set, enables spawn protection for newly spawned players

configurationFields.label: Spawn Protection Duration
configurationFields.description: Sets the duration of spawn protection for newly spawned players. Specify "default" instead of a number to use the default set by the server

configurationFields.label: Allow Shooting During Spawn Protection
configurationFields.description: If set, allows spawn protected players to shoot

configurationFields.label: Team Spawn Protection
configurationFields.description: Sets spawn protection for the selected team(s). Specify the teams in a comma-separated list in square brackets

configurationFields.label: Minimum MTF Time To Spawn
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum time it can take from the last wave for a new one to spawn

configurationFields.label: Maximum MTF Time To Spawn
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum time it can take from the last wave for a new one to spawn

configurationFields.label: Maximum MTF Respawn Amount
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of players who can respawn as MTF

configurationFields.label: Maximum CI Respawn Amount
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of players who can respawn as Chaos Insurgents

configurationFields.label: Prioritise MTF Respawn
configurationFields.description: If set, MTF will be a top priority for a respawn team

configurationFields.label: Use Crypto RNG
configurationFields.description: If set, enables better generation randomness by using a cryptographic random number generator (RNG). Note: Uses more CPU to generate numbers

configurationFields.label: Team Respawn Queue
configurationFields.description: Sets the pattern in which the classes spawn at round start. Specify "default" instead of a number to use the default set by the server

configurationFields.label: Enable Respawn Tickets
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the respawn tickets system. Each MTF or CI player spawned in consumes one ticket. Recommended for game balance. Even if disabled, the MTF:CI ticket ratio will still determine their spawn chance

configurationFields.label: Initial MTF Respawn Tickets Count
configurationFields.description: Sets the starting count for MTF respawn tickets. The ratio of MTF:CI tickets directly determines which team has a higher chance of spawning

configurationFields.label: Initial CI Respawn Tickets Count
configurationFields.description: Sets the starting count for Chaos Insurgents respawn tickets. The ratio of MTF:CI tickets directly determines which team has a higher chance of spawning

configurationFields.label: MTF Respawn Tickets Class D Cuffed Escape Count
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of tickets MTF get for letting a Disarmed Class D escape. Specify "default" instead of a number to use the default set by the server

configurationFields.label: MTF Respawn Tickets Scientist Escape Count
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of tickets MTF get for letting a Scientist escape. Specify "default" instead of a number to use the default set by the server

configurationFields.label: MTF Respawn Tickets SCP Damage Escape Count
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of tickets MTF get for damaging an SCP. Specify "default" instead of a number to use the default set by the server

configurationFields.label: CI Respawn Tickets Class D Escape Count
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of tickets CI get for letting a Class D escape. Specify "default" instead of a number to use the default set by the server

configurationFields.label: CI Respawn Tickets Scientist Cuffed Escape Count
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of tickets CI get for letting a Disarmed Scientist escape. Specify "default" instead of a number to use the default set by the server

configurationFields.label: CI Respawn Tickets Scientist Killing Count
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of tickets CI get for killing a Scientist. Specify "default" instead of a number to use the default set by the server

configurationFields.label: CI Respawn Tickets SCP Item Count
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of tickets CI get when a Class D or Chaos Insurgent uses an SCP item. Specify "default" instead of a number to use the default set by the server

configurationFields.label: Serverversion
configurationFields.description: Sets the server branch to install. Update the server after switching branches

configurationFields.label: EXILED Management Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whether to install or remove the [EXILED plugin framework](https://github.com/ExMod-Team/EXILED) when the server is updated. If set to Remove EXILED, any installed EXILED files will be removed when the server is updated

deploymentSteps.name: EXILED Loader Config.yml Download
deploymentSteps.source:
# Whether EXILED is enabled on this server.
is_enabled: true
# Whether debug messages should be shown.
debug: false
# Indicates whether outdated Exiled versions should be loaded.
should_load_outdated_exiled: true
# Indicates whether outdated plugins should be loaded.
should_load_outdated_plugins: true
# The Exiled directory path from which plugins will be loaded.
exiled_directory_path: AppData/EXILED
# The working environment type (Development, Testing, Production, Ptb, ProductionDebug).
environment: Production
# The config files distribution type (Default, Separated)
config_type: Separated
# Indicates in which quoted strings in configs will be wrapped (Any, SingleQuoted, DoubleQuoted, Folded, Literal).
scalar_style: SingleQuoted
# Indicates in which quoted strings with multiline in configs will be wrapped (Any, SingleQuoted, DoubleQuoted, Folded, Literal).
multi_line_scalar_style: Literal
# Indicates whether testing releases have to be downloaded.
should_download_testing_releases: false
# Indicates which assemblies should be excluded from the updater.
exclude_assemblies: []
# Indicates whether Exiled should auto-update itself as soon as a new release is available.
enable_auto_updates: false
